close_reason: Config::load() + apply_env() added to all 5 binary crates; --config flag now optional
description:
## Why
stoa-4291i: containers must be configurable via environment variables without a config file.

## What
Add Config::from_env_and_file() (or ::load()) to each crate's config.rs:
- mail, smtp, reader, transit, imap configs
- Naming: STOA_<SECTION>_<KEY> in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE
- Precedence: env vars > TOML file > compiled defaults
- Config file becomes optional (no --config flag = use env only)
- Update main.rs in each binary to use new loader

Key vars per epic:
STOA_DB_URL, STOA_DB_MAX_CONNECTIONS, STOA_SMTP_RELAY_HOST,
STOA_TLS_CERT_PATH, STOA_TLS_KEY_PATH, STOA_SECRETS_PROVIDER,
STOA_LOG_FORMAT, STOA_LOG_LEVEL

## Acceptance
- Binary starts with zero config file and all config via env vars
- Tests covering env-var override of each key config field
title: Env-var overlay for all Config structs (STOA_ prefix)
